# Foundry page and knowledge maps — organization scope v1

The existing page plan is v1.1-candidate. Its mockup and map research stay available with their original review and approval records; this cockpit does not accept or replace them. Poincaré is the corrected name in John’s October 3 source record. Piaget remains the separate learning-cycle concept.

**Placement:** Active under Ghost World Labs. **Source:** John’s original Campaign turn 3c476265-7142-441c-a934-a7a37d5a1e98, 2026-10-04. **Owner:** Skill Foundry / Foundry page and knowledge maps.

## John’s words

"redo the skill foundry page And add process maps to each of the skills, and then record how the skills are used and built up knowledge maps"

## Requested scope

1. The revised page, process maps for every Foundry skill, activity recording, usage-derived knowledge maps and their integration belong to this one initiative.

2. The current page plan initially traces researchPrime and Gandalf. Preserve that proposal and its review; John’s new initiative includes eventual coverage of all skills, without silently declaring the current page plan approved.

3. Keep the distinction between a seeded diagram and a map calibrated from real runs. The earlier Poincaré concept proposes Lorentz computation and Poincaré display; measured benefit and the research/plan’s approval stay source-qualified.

4. Stargazer is a proposed new Foundry skill inside this initiative: broad attentiveness, rumination and noticing nonobvious patterns, inspired by The Master and His Emissary. This organization does not create, install or change a skill.

5. The Foundry owns skill-facing process and knowledge views. The harness initiative owns runtime cognitive structures. A shared map format is a proposed integration seam, not a prerequisite for reviewing the page.

## Authorization and acceptance

John authorized this organization and placement. Each product keeps its own feedback, version and acceptance; no slice is closed here. Current records do not approve a new implementation plan. Publishing, domain purchases, a final license, credential changes, folder moves, token trials and deferred builds remain outside this organization.

## Plan boundary

This is a scope map, not a build sequence. Cockpit discovery must settle load-bearing choices before a substantial implementation plan. Setup and Distribution share one installation/connection flow; the other products can be reviewed independently. Nothing was cut from John’s requested scope. Implementation scheduling was excluded here because unresolved product choices would make it premature.
